name: Hillsboro
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hillsboro, OR 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Hillsboro, OR: Winter Village ice rink at Orenco Station, a free holiday drone show, Snow Much Fun with Santa and wetland goats.
lede: Hillsboro builds its Christmas around Winter Village, a covered ice rink at Orenco Station, and adds a free holiday drone show at the ballpark, hourly snow flurries with Santa, a wetlands winter day with baby goats and Santa photos at Tanasbourne.
celebrates: The season starts downtown with Holly Days and the tree lighting before Thanksgiving. On November 29 Hillsboro Parks and Recreation opens the Winter Village ice rink on Jerry Willey Plaza at Orenco Station, a MAX stop, and keeps it open into January. The Streets of Tanasbourne holds Merry Making with free Santa photos on December 5. Jackson Bottom Wetlands Preserve hosts a Winter Wonderland with baby goats a week later. The week before Christmas brings three nights of free drone shows at Hillsboro Ballpark, and Snow Much Fun, with hourly snow flurries and Santa at Winter Village.
lastyear: In 2025 the Hillsboro Holly Days Celebration filled downtown Hillsboro on Saturday, November 22, from 2 to 7 pm. Families found children's activities, live music and a busy artisan market, and the holiday tree was lit at 6 pm. The Hillsboro School District shared the invitation with families in both English and Spanish. In 2026 Holly Days was held on Saturday, November 21, so it has already taken place this season.
facts: Hillsboro grew around the land claim of David Hill, a farmer who came to the East Tualatin Plains in the late 1830s. In 1843 he opened the area's first post office in a corner of his cabin and named it Columbus. Columbus became the seat of the new Washington County in 1849, and after Hill died in 1850 the town was renamed Hillsborough in his honor. The spelling was later shortened to Hillsboro, and the town grew to 2,016 people by 1910.
trains: Trains changed Hillsboro more than once. The Willamette Valley Railroad reached the county seat in 1872, and in 1908 the Oregon Electric Railway brought electric commuter trains from Portland, stopping where Hillsboro Central MAX Station stands today. Passenger trains stopped in 1932, and rail returned in 1998 when TriMet's MAX opened from Gresham to Hillsboro. Today the Blue Line stops at Orenco Station, next to Winter Village, and rides on through Washington Park to downtown Portland.

kidfact: Hillsboro's first post office was in the corner of a farmer's log cabin. The farmer was David Hill, and the town was later named after him.
faq: When does the Hillsboro ice rink open in 2026?

The Winter Village ice rink at Orenco Station opens on November 29, 2026, and runs until January 10, 2027. Weekday sessions are at 4, 5:30 and 7 pm, with daytime sessions on weekends and over winter break. Tickets are $19, or $16 for ages 13 and under.
Where can kids see Santa in Hillsboro for free?

The Streets of Tanasbourne offers free photos with Santa at Merry Making on December 5 from 2 to 5 pm. On December 19, Santa poses for free photos at Snow Much Fun at Winter Village from 10 am to 3 pm, and the December 19 drone show has a Santa theme.
Is the Hillsboro drone show free?

Yes. Light Up the Sky at Hillsboro Ballpark is free on December 17, 18 and 19, 2026, with free parking in designated lots. Gates open at 6 pm for cookie decorating, ornament making and games, and the drone show starts at 7 pm.
When was Holly Days in Hillsboro this year?

Hillsboro Holly Days and the downtown tree lighting took place on Saturday, November 21, 2026, the weekend before Thanksgiving. Families who missed it can still skate at Winter Village, watch the free drone show at the ballpark and visit the free Santa photo events in December.
Can we take MAX to Hillsboro Christmas events?

Yes. The Winter Village rink and Snow Much Fun are at Orenco Station, which has its own stop on the MAX Blue Line. The Red Line also stops there, and free parking in the Rowlock and Vector garages covers the first 2 hours for families who drive.
